notes: Seed elections page and the 'Election Results' page (located by one web search) both return HTTP 403 'Access Denied' (Akamai edgesuite reference), i.e. bot protection; not circumvented. No Clarity site (elections.json 404) and no other vendor results site found. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin). Targeted pass 2026-10-02 (targeted-Brazoria): no election decided; tag and results unchanged. Tried: (1) wayback-data branch: phase1/wayback_snapshots/Brazoria/index.json has every CDX query failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable), 0 captures; phase1/targeted/archives/Brazoria and phase1/targeted/wayback/Brazoria not present on the branch at start or at finish. (2) web.archive.org (CDX and robots.txt), timetravel.mementoweb.org timemap and archive.ph timemap all refused by the fetch module (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). (3) archive.org/wayback/available (reachable) closest-capture lookups: election-results page closest to each election night is 20241203234611 and 20260315212625 (UTC), so no election-night capture of the results page exists in Wayback; /departments/elections closest are 20241007150925, 20260303233907 (5:39 PM CST, before polls closed) and 20260526203902 (3:39 PM CDT, before polls closed); home page 20241106172036 (11:20 AM CST Nov 6), 20260303212134, 20260529231036. None is on election night, and replays cannot be read here anyway. (4) Non-www host brazoriacountyclerktx.gov also returns HTTP 403 (same protection); not pursued further. No vendor results site (Clarity or other) found by search; county results are CivicPlus showpublisheddocument PDFs on the protected host, and the ones surfaced by search are canvass or later versions (not evidence, search text only). (5) Check 4 news: Community Impact 2026 primary county-judge article (published 2026-03-04 12:50 UTC) gives county totals only, with a 10:30 p.m. update quoting totals 'As of 9:45 p.m.' 'according to unofficial results from Brazoria County'; The Facts primary-night articles (published 2026-03-03 21:02 CST and 2026-03-04 16:09 CST) give county totals and state the county 'did not upload its first batch of early voting results until about 9:54 p.m.'; The Facts '2026 Brazoria County primary vote totals' (2026-03-04 17:57 CST) is a county-total table; The Facts runoff article (2026-05-26 22:36 CDT) cites 'Unofficial results released Tuesday night by the Brazoria County Elections Division' with county totals only; no Houston Chronicle precinct map found. No third-party page shows per-precinct candidate votes, so check 4 decides nothing. These are leads that county totals were posted on 2026 primary and runoff nights, but no county file with an election-night run or upload time survives, so LATER cannot be applied. Leads left: targeted archive results for Brazoria (not yet on the branch); Wayback replays of the 2026-03-03 23:39 UTC and 2026-05-26 20:39 UTC /departments/elections captures could show which results link or vendor the county used.
